refnamediv.refpurpose: Start closing the KafkaConsumer without waiting

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public voidRdKafka\KafkaConsumer::closeAsync
Starts leaving the consumer group and returns without waiting for it to finish.
Keep calling RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::consume so that rebalance, offset commit and other callbacks run while the group hands the consumer's partitions over. Messages and errors can still be returned; the application decides what to do with them. Once RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::isClosed returns &true;, call RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close to release the consumer.
Calling this method again while the consumer is closing does nothing.
RdKafka\KafkaConsumer::close is still needed to release the consumer, and it can block while librdkafka shuts down, even after the asynchronous close has finished. Topics and queues obtained from the consumer stay valid until then.
Requires librdkafka 1.9.0 or later. The method does not exist when the extension is built with an older version.
